scope: Local execution of actual component event handlers in a controlled hook/storage environment. Not a browser, not visual QA, and no live model calls. Sheet/Switch/Progress primitives are test wrappers. Network failures are injected deliberately.

checks.name: Fresh visitor completes Arabic two-step onboarding with real time default
Language changes to English with LTR and persists across reload
Pinned preview selection survives reload; Return to now restores live time
Adhan reader has seven lines and reaches reading step 15
All five moments open with three dimensions and source disclosures
Understanding a moment awards one persisted stamp without duplicates
Six-stop journey, wrong and right quiz answers, matching and earned stamp
Visit interest and edited conversation card save on device and reload
Chat failure shows one clear error and no suggested clarification
Retry sends the same request without duplicating the visitor question
Typed follow-up carries canonical claim IDs from the last answer
A refusal clears context for the next typed follow-up
Detail refresh restores both moment and selected branch
Prayer time details also survive refresh
Clear data removes stored data and locks later journey stations immediately
Direct judge route bypasses onboarding for a fresh visitor
Settings city and iqamah bounds persist
Arabic moment cards retain all supplied dimensions and source labels
Discovery failure shows the service error without a clarification question
Unavailable storage does not claim that interest was saved
Clear handler race guard aborts and discards late response (handler invoked directly while navigation is disabled)
